description: Bookmark functions and lines with your own names. They stay in place after git pull.
container.title: Bookmarks
view.tree.name: Bookmarks
config.detection.source.rules: Use detection rules; fall back to the language server for languages without rules.
config.detection.source.languageServer: Always use the language server (rules are ignored).
config.detection.source.both: Combine rules and the language server; duplicates on the same line are removed.
config.detection.rules: Your own detection rules. A rule with the same `id` as a built-in rule overrides it. `pattern` is a regular expression that must contain a `(?<name>...)` group (unless `nameTemplate` or `body: "embedded"` is used); the body is searched from where the match ends.
config.detection.disabledRules: IDs of built-in rules to turn off, e.g. `ts-method`. `html-id` is off by default.
config.detection.templateFiles: Glob patterns of files where the built-in Django / HTML rules apply.
config.followCursor: Highlight the function under the cursor in the side bar.
config.rule.id: Unique ID. Use a built-in ID to override that rule.
config.rule.label: Short description shown in tooltips.
config.rule.languages: Language IDs this rule applies to, e.g. typescript, python, html.
config.rule.pattern: Regular expression with a (?<name>...) group (unless nameTemplate or body "embedded" is used).
config.rule.flags: Extra regular expression flags, e.g. i.
config.rule.kind: Kind of symbol; decides the icon.
config.rule.body: How to find where the symbol ends: brace, indent, pair, line, call, heading, embedded, end (the next end at the same indentation, as in Ruby), statement (to the end of the SQL statement: ;, GO, / or DELIMITER), indentBlock (the line plus the more-indented lines after it, as in Haskell) or braceOrIndent (braces if the header has {, otherwise the more-indented lines after it, as in Scala 3).
config.rule.end: Regular expression for the closing tag (pair) or the end of the region (embedded).
config.rule.embeddedLanguage: Language whose rules apply inside the region (embedded).
config.rule.within: Only count the symbol when it is inside one of these kinds, e.g. ["class"].
config.rule.include: Only apply to files matching these glob patterns.
config.rule.enabled: Set to false to turn the rule off.
command.toggleFavorite: Add / Remove Function Bookmark (Function at Cursor)
command.goToParentBlock: Go to Overridden Block in Parent Template
config.django.templateDirs: Extra Django template folders, relative to the workspace folder (like `DIRS` in `TEMPLATES`). Folders named `templates` are searched automatically.
config.storage: Default storage location for bookmarks, display names and notes across all workspaces. To use a different location for one workspace, run "Function Bookmarks: Choose Bookmark Storage for This Workspace…".
config.storage.workspaceState: Editor workspace storage (no file is created).
config.project.include: Glob of files listed under **Whole project** and used by **Search Functions**.
config.project.exclude: Globs excluded from **Whole project** and **Search Functions**.
config.rule.nameTemplate: Build the name from several groups, e.g. ${type:upper|AJAX} ${url}. `:upper` upper-cases, `|default` is used when the group did not match.
config.rule.matchRaw: Match against the original text so string contents (e.g. 'click', '/api') can be captured. Matches starting inside comments or strings are still skipped.
config.rule.hideChildren: Rule IDs whose child symbols are hidden under this one, e.g. ajax success/error callbacks.
config.rule.optionalBody: Allow a brace body to be omitted or written as an expression (e.g. Kotlin/Swift data classes or `=` expressions) without consuming the next `{`.
config.rule.mergeClauses: Merge adjacent symbols with the same name and kind into one, e.g. Elixir function clauses or a Haskell type signature and its equations.
command.searchClearAndClose: Clear Search and Close Search Bar
config.onLineDelete: What happens to a bookmark when its line is deleted in the editor.
config.onLineDelete.moveToNext: Move it to the next line.
config.onLineDelete.markLost: Move it to the next line and mark it as "needs checking".
config.hover.enabled: When hovering a function name, show a popup to add / remove the bookmark, rename, and edit the note.
command.hideNotOnBranch: Hide Bookmarks Not on This Branch
command.showNotOnBranch: Show Bookmarks Not on This Branch
command.cleanBranchRecords: Clean Up Records of Deleted Branches
command.chooseStorage: Choose Bookmark Storage for This Workspace…
command.deleteBookmarkSource: Delete All Bookmarks from This Source
config.authorName: Your name in exported bookmarks. Defaults to git `user.name`.
command.toggleNumberedBookmark: Set / Remove Numbered Bookmark on This Line
command.testDetectionRules: Test Detection Rules on This File
config.notes.closeOnSave: Automatically close the note editor and preview tabs after saving (`Ctrl+S` / `Cmd+S`). Turn off to keep editing and save repeatedly.
config.bookmarks.autoNumber: Give every new bookmark the next free number (1–9), so you can jump to it with `Alt+Shift+B 1`–`9` (`Ctrl+Shift+B 1`–`9` on macOS). You can always set or change a number with *Set Bookmark Number…* or `Alt+Shift+B Shift+1`–`9`.
config.bookmarks.showLabelAtLineEnd: Show the bookmark name (and number) faintly at the end of the bookmarked line. Only for bookmarks with a name, a number, or from someone else.
config.bookmarks.navigationScope: Scope of **Next Bookmark** and **Previous Bookmark** (does not affect numbered bookmark tour).
config.bookmarks.navigationScope.all: Navigate across bookmarks in all files.
config.bookmarks.navigationScope.current: Only navigate among bookmarks in the current file (falls back to all files when no editor is active).
config.bookmarks.navigationWrap: Wrap around when reaching the first or last bookmark with **Next Bookmark** / **Previous Bookmark**. Turn off to stop at either end.
config.statusBar.enabled: Show the number of bookmarks in the current file in the status bar, with the source filter and hidden-icon state. Click it to search bookmarks.
